name: coup-de-grace-prepare-4-paid-non-assassin-no-critical
notes: Coup de Grace (5qWWpkgQLl, NORM ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 4, printed power 4): "Prepare 4. [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Coup de Grace was prepared, it gains critical 4." Player 2 keeps the deck's default Spirit of Fire champion (class SPIRIT, not an Assassin) with 4 preparation counters: Prepare 4 is payable (counters spent, card tagged PREPARED) but the critical 4 is a [Class Bonus] and is NOT granted: 4 damage (not 8) and no 'Discard 4' offer is made to player 1.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Coup de Grace was prepared, it gains critical 4.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Second defect behind this card's Prepare wiring: its generated onAttackAbilities['5qWWpkgQLl:0'] (critical 4) gated '[Class Bonus]' with IsClassBonusActive($player) called with NO required-classes list, which only checks 'controls any champion' (always true), so a prepared copy played by a non-Assassin champion would still have gotten the rider. Fix: GAWrapClassBonusGate() in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php re-gates it on ASSASSIN (live: the unwrapped rider fired for a Spirit of Fire champion).
